target: forge.sh remote — FORGE_REMOTE env, then .forge.remote, else origin
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/o/r.git
k() { fx_run remote; echo "$1=$FX_OUT"; }
k default
fx_config '{"forge":{"remote":"upstream"}}'
k cfg
export FORGE_REMOTE=mirror; k env
export FORGE_REMOTE=; k envempty
fx_done
